adjustment.description: The revenue this month's journal books: earned less held; negative when invoiced ahead of progress.

contract_asset.description: The contract asset after the journal: earned and not yet invoiced.

contract_liability.description: The contract liability after the journal: invoiced and not yet earned.

cost_to_date.description: What progress is measured by: the project's costs posted to the end of the month (direct and payroll-tagged) less those left out as not showing progress.

costs_left_out.description: The part of them the accountant left out of progress, with the reason on the election.

costs_posted.description: The project's costs posted to the end of the month, before any are left out.

earned.description: The revenue earned to date: RND-RECOGNISE of the fee by progress.

fee.description: The fixed fee: the total of the project's milestones.

held.description: The revenue the ledger holds for the project to date.

invoiced.description: The revenue invoiced to the project to date, net of GST: the revenue the ledger holds less the earlier journals' adjustments.

overrun.description: The cost has reached the estimate: the whole fee is earned and the estimate needs revisiting.

progress.description: Cost to date over the estimate as a percentage, at most 100.0 (RND-PERCENT).
